core_question: How do I fluff suede shoes back up after the nap has gone flat and matted? (secondary: How should I store leather shoes for months so they don't get damaged?)
answer_summary: Hold the suede over steam for a few seconds to loosen the flattened fibers, then brush briskly with a suede brush to raise the nap back up.; after the topic shift: Clean and condition the shoes, insert shoe trees to hold their shape and absorb moisture, then store them in breathable cloth/dust bags (not sealed plastic) in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight.
